hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Palo Alto, California as headquarters; CB Insights lists a Palo Alto headquarters address.

public_docs.notes: The site footer lists Typeface Academy and a resource hub, but not a public product documentation or developer portal; a public API documentation portal with several articles was not found.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round located is the June 2023 Series B, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

last_funding.notes: The company announcement describes a $100 million Series B, announced June 29, 2023.

launched_6mo.notes: Typeface announced the next generation of its Orchestration Engine on September 22, 2026, within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage and footer offer demo/contact-sales calls to action but no pricing link or public pricing page.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports a 304 employee count as of September 30, 2026; that falls in the 201-500 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Enterprise Account Executive—East and Enterprise Account Executive—West.

model_provider.notes: The IT Teams page names Gemini 3 among the platform's foundation models. The orchestration-engine post mentions integrations with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and MCP.
model_provider.value: Google Gemini models (including Gemini 3); Typeface also describes support for Claude and ChatGPT integrations, but does not identify those as its underlying model providers.

named_customers.notes: This company blog page explicitly names Microsoft and ASICS as brands using or partnering with Typeface.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists a Senior ML Engineer role.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited page claims SOC 2 Type II compliance and ISO 27001 certification. It also names ISO 27701 and ISO 42001, which are not included because the requested list is limited to SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable homepage and open job listings reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.

product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes the platform and enterprise marketing audience.
product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an enterprise marketing AI platform that orchestrates AI agents, brand intelligence, and workflows to help enterprise marketing teams create personalized, on-brand campaigns.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No verifiable dated announcement or profile establishing a C-level or VP-level join/departure in the period was found; the available company leadership information is not sufficient to support a negative claim.
